svg.title: Mapped and unmapped schemas collapse into tabs
svg.desc: A faithful vector reconstruction of the nine-second wireframe video. Separate Mapped and Unmapped lists merge into a tabbed source; a second source slides in with a small bounce; three narrower sources then fit alongside the unchanged master schema. The sources fade out and the sequence repeats.
svg.metadata: Source: mch-wireframe-extended.mp4. Original: 1400 × 792, 30 fps, 271 frames. Source geometry and transition positions sampled from the supplied video; blank rows intentionally preserved.
